**Security vulnerability identified: No execution timeout on the Otto VM — Denial of Service (DoS) risk.**

The `vm.Run(conditionScript)` call has no timeout or interrupt mechanism. A malicious or poorly written script (e.g., `while(true) {}`) would run indefinitely, causing a denial of service. This is a critical vulnerability for any system that accepts user-provided scripts.

The Otto VM supports an `Interrupt` channel that can be used to halt execution. I'll add a timeout mechanism using this feature.
